title: The Day of the Lord Will Come

questions.question: knowing this first of all, that ____ will come in the last days with scoffing, following their own sinful desires.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:3 (ESV): "knowing this first of all, that scoffers will come in the last days with scoffing, following their own sinful desires."

questions.question: They will say, "Where is the promise of his ____? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, all things are continuing as they were from the beginning of creation."
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:4 (ESV): "They will say, 'Where is the promise of his coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, all things are continuing as they were from the beginning of creation.'"

questions.question: For they deliberately overlook this fact, that the heavens existed long ago, and the earth was formed out of ____ and through ____ by the word of God,
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:5 (ESV): "For they deliberately overlook this fact, that the heavens existed long ago, and the earth was formed out of water and through water by the word of God,"

questions.question: and that by means of these the world that then existed was deluged with water and ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:6 (ESV): "and that by means of these the world that then existed was deluged with water and perished."

questions.question: But by the same word the heavens and earth that now exist are stored up for ____, being kept until the day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:7 (ESV): "But by the same word the heavens and earth that now exist are stored up for fire, being kept until the day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly."

questions.question: But do not overlook this one fact, beloved, that with the Lord one day is as a thousand ____, and a thousand ____ as one day.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:8 (ESV): "But do not overlook this one fact, beloved, that with the Lord one day is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day."

questions.question: The Lord is not slow to fulfill his promise as some count slowness, but is ____ toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should reach repentance.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:9 (ESV): "The Lord is not slow to fulfill his promise as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should reach repentance."

questions.question: The Lord does not wish that any should perish, but that all should reach ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:9 (ESV): "The Lord is not slow to fulfill his promise as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should reach repentance."

questions.question: But the day of the Lord will come like a ____, and then the heavens will pass away with a roar...
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:10 (ESV): "But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, and then the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the heavenly bodies will be burned up and dissolved, and the earth and the works that are done on it will be exposed."

questions.question: and the ____ bodies will be burned up and dissolved, and the earth and the works that are done on it will be exposed.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:10 (ESV): "But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, and then the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the heavenly bodies will be burned up and dissolved, and the earth and the works that are done on it will be exposed."

questions.question: waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be set on ____ and dissolved...
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:12 (ESV): "waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be set on fire and dissolved, and the heavenly bodies will melt as they burn!"

questions.question: But according to his promise we are waiting for new heavens and a new earth in which ____ dwells.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:13 (ESV): "But according to his promise we are waiting for new heavens and a new earth in which righteousness dwells."

questions.question: And count the patience of our Lord as salvation, just as our beloved brother ____ also wrote to you according to the wisdom given him,
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:15 (ESV): "And count the patience of our Lord as salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you according to the wisdom given him,"

questions.question: as he does in all his letters when he speaks in them of these matters. There are some things in them that are hard to ____, which the ignorant and unstable twist to their own destruction, as they do the other Scriptures.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:16 (ESV): "as he does in all his letters when he speaks in them of these matters. There are some things in them that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unstable twist to their own destruction, as they do the other Scriptures."

questions.question: But grow in the ____ and ____ of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 3:18 (ESV): "But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen."

key_verse_text: The Lord is not slow to fulfill his promise as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should reach repentance.
